# The radar toolchain: the slow, noisy or heavyweight checks that must not
# sit in the blocking lanes. Kept apart from requirements-ci.txt on purpose —
# semgrep drags a large dependency tree (pydantic, mcp) behind it, and
# pinning that into the toolchain every other job installs would make a
# semgrep bump a pipeline-wide event. Dependabot watches /.github, so this
# file gets its own reviewable bump PRs.

# Imports vs declared dependencies: this repo keeps requirements.txt,
# requirements.lock and pyproject.toml, and nothing else compares them.
deptry==0.25.1

# Bug and security patterns beyond bandit's rule set (p/python registry).
semgrep==1.177.0

# Dead code: functions, imports and variables nothing reaches.
vulture==2.16

# Second type checker. It disagrees with mypy often enough to be worth a
# radar cell; the nodejs extra bundles node, or pyright downloads one
# through nodeenv on every run.
pyright[nodejs]==1.1.414
